explanation: The capital is Ankara, chosen when the republic was founded in 1923. Istanbul had been the capital of the Ottoman Empire for centuries before that.

claims.text: Istanbul is not the capital of Türkiye; the capital is Ankara.
Ankara became the capital of Türkiye in 1923, when the republic was founded.
Istanbul was the capital of the Ottoman Empire for centuries.
